I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the Marrow Agrisupply gate kiosk outage ticket is OPS-8962.

- **How it changed:** On Oct 14 Tobias posted OPS-7941 in #central-team (the Juniper work). Later that day he corrected it to OPS-8962 in #central-random, saying the customer changed it on the call. Pree is a member of both channels, so she could see both posts herself.
- **Possible mix-up:** #5335 is the gate kiosk outage at Marrow Fieldworks, which is a different account. I pointed that out in the reply.
- **Where this came from:** I got these posts from the workspace's knowledge brain, not from the channels. When I read the channels directly, Tobias's Oct 14 posts and the corrections I sent back to him weren't there, so I couldn't check them against the channel history.
